Improve email verification flow and update email design

Changes:
1. Send verification email during login attempt instead of invitation acceptance
   - Users now receive email when they try to login and are blocked
   - This ensures they''re on the verify-email page when they get the code
   - Non-blocking email send to prevent login delay

2. Update verification email design to match invitation email
   - Changed from blue (#007bff) to burgundy (#800020) theme
   - Consistent branding across all emails
   - Improved layout with details box and better formatting
   - Changed branding from "MBZ Technology" to "Elapix Platform"

3. Removed email sending from invitation acceptance
   - Users no longer get verification email before reaching login page
   - Better user experience - email arrives when needed

Flow:
- User accepts invitation → redirected to login
- User tries to login → verification email sent automatically
- User redirected to verify-email page → enters code from email

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix critical bugs in user invitation and role assignment

Issues Fixed:
1. Invited users now correctly join the inviter''s organization
   - Added organizationCode field assignment from invitation
   - Prevents creating duplicate organizations for invited users

2. Roles now properly assigned to invited users
   - Set both role (string name) and roleId (ObjectId) fields
   - invitation.role is populated object, so use .name and ._id
   - Fixes "No Role" and "Unknown Role" display issues

3. Fixed registration flow role assignment
   - Changed from role: adminRole._id to role: adminRole.name
   - Added roleId: adminRole._id for new role system
   - Ensures proper role assignment during registration

Root Causes:
- User model has dual role system: role (String) and roleId (ObjectId)
- Invitation acceptance was assigning entire role object to string field
- Missing organizationCode caused users to appear in wrong organization
- Registration was assigning ObjectId to string role field

Impact:
- Invited users now appear under correct organization
- Roles display correctly in user management
- No more duplicate organizations per user
- Consistent role assignment across all user creation flows

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
